title: Transcutaneous Electrical Nerve Stimulation on Pain Intensity of Patients With Hip Arthroplasty
brief_summary: Fifty patients with hip arthroplasty were purposively recruited for the study. They were allocated into two groups randomly with equal number. One group had TEN, other served as control. Pain intensity was measured every day of the treatment.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

Patients who recently had hip arthroplasty were recruited for this study

Exclusion Criteria:

* Subjects who had surgery but have infected wounds.
* Patients who had deep vein thrombosis post-surgery.
* Patients who had thrombophlebitis post-surgery.
